title:
This epic is used to filter side panel card list results from the side panel search bar.
If the search query (retrieved from action's payload) is cleared, the card list is reset to the original state.

The payload accepts following props:
`queryString` - query applied on `fields` to generate filter.
`fields` - fields used for generating the filter in the epic using the `queryString`.
`filter` - any additional filter to apply to the generated filter in the epic
`filterOp` - the operator like  `&&` or `||` to aggregate the additional `filter`.
`appStateFilterSpec` - any additional filter to apply to the generated filter based on a field in an application state.
       `appStateId` - an application state id to retrieve a desired value from.
       `appStateField` - the field in the application state to retrieve the value from.
       `appStateFilterExpressionStart` - the start of the filter expression to apply to the value retrieved from the application state.
       `appStateFilterExpressionEnd` - the end of the filter expression to apply to the value retrieved from the application state.

For example, when searching on `searchQuery` with the following payload:
```
payload: {
 "queryString": "searchQuery"
 "fields": ["name", "criticalityLevel"],
 "filter": "someOtherCondition",
 "filterOp": "&&"
 "appStateFilterSpec": {
   "appStateId": "Reliability.ReliabilityApplicationState",
   "appStateField": "selectedFacilities",
   "appStateFilterExpressionStart": "intersects(facility.id, ",
   "appStateFilterExpressionEnd": ")"
 }
}
```
The final filter generated and applied would be,
`( containsIgnoreCase('name', "searchQuery") || containsIgnoreCase('criticalityLevel', "searchQuery") ) &&  someOtherCondition`
name: UiSdlEpicSearchFromSidePanel
